build_TransformerModel: build a transformer language model using TransformerModel with TransConfig for sequence prediction
create_MultiheadAttention: create a MultiheadAttention module with configurable heads and dropout for self-attention
build_TransformerEncoder: build a TransformerEncoder stack from cloned TransformerEncoderLayer instances with optional normalization
generate_square_subsequent_mask: generate a square subsequent mask tensor with negative infinity above the diagonal
create_PositionalEncoding: create a PositionalEncoding module that adds sinusoidal position embeddings to input tensors
